api_url.description: The URL of the Border0 API. Can also be set with the `BORDER0_API` environment variable. Defaults to `https://api.border0.com/api/v1`.

http_client_timeout.description: The timeout for each HTTP request. Can also be set with the `BORDER0_HTTP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT` environment variable. Defaults to `30s`.

token.description: The auth token used to authenticate with the Border0 API. Can also be set with the `BORDER0_TOKEN` environment variable. If you need to generate a Border0 access token, go to [Border0 Admin Portal](https://portal.border0.com) -> Organization Settings -> Access Tokens, create a token in `Member` permission groups.

built_in_ssh_service_enabled.description: Whether to expose the connector as an ssh service.

built_in_ssh_service_id.description: The socket id of the built-in ssh service.

name.description: The name of the connector. Connector name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

tailscale_auth_key.description: The Tailscale auth key for this connector. Only populated on create for Tailscale-managed organizations.

block.description: The connector resource allows you to create and manage a Border0 connector.

expires_at.description: The expiration date and time of the token. Leave empty for no expiration.

name.description: The name of the connector token. Connector token name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

block.description: The connector token resource allows you to create and delete a token for a Border0 connector.

display_name.description: The display name for the user. A friendly name to help distinguish it among other users.

members.description: Set of user ids (members of the group)

block.description: The group resource allows you to create and manage Border0 groups.

name.description: The name of the policy. Policy name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

org_wide.description: Whether the policy should be applied to all sockets in the organization.

policy_data.description: The policy data. This is a JSON string.

tag_rules.description: A list of tag rules to apply to the sockets that this policy is applied to.

version.description: The version of the policy. The default value is 'v2', the other valid value is 'v1'.

block.description: The policy resource allows you to create and manage a Border0 policy.

policy_id.description: The ID of the policy to attach.

socket_id.description: The ID of the socket to attach the policy to.

active.description: Whether the service account should be active or not. Defaults to true

name.description: The name for the user in slug format. Must be unique per organization.

role.description: The role for the service account. Currently valid values include 'admin', 'member', 'read only', and 'client'.

block.description: The service account resource allows you to create and manage Border0 service accounts.

expires_at.description: The expiration date and time of the token. Leave empty for no expiration.

name.description: The name of the service account token. Service account token name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

service_account_name.description: The name of the service account.

block.description: The service account token resource allows you to create and delete a token for a Border0 service account.

connector_id.description: The ID of the connector that the socket is attached to.

connector_ids.description: The ID(s) of the connector(s) that the socket is attached to.

display_name.description: An additional display name of the socket. Less restrictive than the `name` field and does not need to be unique.

name.description: The name of the socket. Must be unique within your Border0 organization. Socket name can have alphanumerics and hyphens, but it must start or end with alphanumeric.

recording_enabled.description: Indicates if session recording is enabled for the socket.

socket_type.description: The type of the socket. Valid values: `ssh`, `http`, `database`, `tls`, `vnc`, `rdp`, `subnet_router`, `exit_node`, `snowflake`, `elasticsearch`, `kubernetes`, `aws_s3`.

upstream_type.description: The upstream type of the socket.

access_key_id.description: The upstream AWS access key id.

secret_access_key.description: The upstream AWS secret access key.

block.description: The upstream service's AWS credentials.

authentication_type.description: The upstream authentication type. Valid values: `username_and_password`, `tls`, `iam`. Defaults to `username_and_password`.

azure_ad_auth.description: Indicates if Azure AD authentication is enabled. Only used when service type is `azure_sql`.

azure_ad_integrated.description: Indicates if Azure integrated authentication is enabled. Only used when service type is `azure_sql`.

certificate.description: The upstream certificate. Only used when authentication type is `tls`.

cloudsql_connector_enabled.description: Indicates if CloudSQL connector is enabled. Only used when service type is `gcp_cloud_sql`.

cloudsql_iam_auth.description: Indicates if GCP IAM authentication is enabled. Only used when service type is `gcp_cloud_sql`.

cloudsql_instance_id.description: The upstream CloudSQL instance id. Only used when service type is `gcp_cloud_sql`.

cluster_region.description: The upstream DocumentDB upstream database region. Only used when service type is `aws_documentdb`, and authentication type is `iam`.

database_name.description: The upstream database name. Only used when service type is `standard`, `aws_rds`, or `aws_documentdb`.

kerberos_auth.description: Indicates if Kerberos authentication is enabled. Only used when service type is `azure_sql`.

password.description: The upstream password. Used when authentication type is either `username_and_password` or `tls`.

private_key.description: The upstream private key. Only used when authentication type is `tls`.

protocol.description: The upstream database protocol. Valid values: `mysql`, `postgres` or `cockroachdb`. Defaults to `mysql`.

rds_instance_region.description: The upstream RDS database region. Only used when service type is `aws_rds`, and authentication type is `iam`.

service_type.description: The upstream service type. Valid values: `standard`, `aws_rds`, `gcp_cloud_sql`, `azure_sql`. Defaults to `standard`.

sql_auth.description: Indicates if standard SQL authentication (username and password) is enabled. Only used when service type is `azure_sql`.

tls_auth.description: Indicates if TLS authentication is enabled. Only used when service type is `gcp_cloud_sql`.

username.description: The upstream username. Used when authentication type is either `username_and_password` or `tls`.

secret_access_key.description: The upstream AWS secret access key.

service_type.description: The upstream service type. Valid values: `standard`

file_server_directory.description: The upstream file server directory. Only used when service type is `connector_file_server`.

host_header.description: The upstream host header. Only used when service type is `standard`, and it's different from the hostname in `upstream_url`.

service_type.description: The upstream service type. Valid values: `standard`, `connector_file_server`. Defaults to `standard`.

upstream_url.description: The upstream HTTP URL. Format: `http(s)://<hostname>:<port>`. Example: `https://example.com` or `http://another.example.com:8080`. Only used when service type is `standard`.

values.description: List of values for the header. Multiple values are supported.

block.description: Custom HTTP headers forwarded to the upstream service. Each header has a key and a list of values.

certificate_authority.description: The path to the certificate authority file. If not specified, it will use the certificate authority from the kubeconfig file.

certificate_authority_data.description: The base64 encoded certificate authority data. If not specified, it will use the certificate authority data from the kubeconfig file.

client_certificate.description: The path to the client certificate file. If not specified, it will use the client certificate from the kubeconfig file.

client_certificate_data.description: The base64 encoded client certificate data. If not specified, it will use the client certificate data from the kubeconfig file.

client_key.description: The path to the client key file. If not specified, it will use the client key from the kubeconfig file.

client_key_data.description: The base64 encoded client key data. If not specified, it will use the client key data from the kubeconfig file.

context.description: The Kubernetes context to use. If not specified, it will use the current context from the kubeconfig file.

eks_cluster_name.description: The name of the AWS EKS cluster. Only used when service type is `aws_eks`.

eks_cluster_region.description: The AWS region of the EKS cluster. Only used when service type is `aws_eks`.

impersonation_enabled.description: Indicates whether to set impersonation headers e.g. "Impersonate-User" and "Impersonate-Groups".

kubeconfig_path.description: The path to the kubeconfig file. Default it will use the system's kubeconfig file.

server.description: The Kubernetes API server URL. If not specified, it will use the server URL from the kubeconfig file.

service_type.description: The upstream service type. Valid values: `standard`, `aws_eks`. Defaults to `standard`.

token.description: The Kubernetes API token. If not specified, it will use the token from the kubeconfig file.

token_file.description: The path to the file containing the Kubernetes API token. If not specified, it will use the token from the kubeconfig file.

container_name_allowlist.description: List of allowed container names (supports wildcards). Only used when service type is `docker_exec`.

ec2_instance_id.description: The upstream EC2 instance id. Used when service type is either `aws_ec2_instance_connect` or `aws_ssm`.

ec2_instance_region.description: The upstream EC2 instance region. Used when service type is either `aws_ec2_instance_connect` or `aws_ssm` (SSM target type is `ec2`).

ecs_cluster_name.description: The upstream ECS cluster name. Only used when service type is `aws_ssm`, and SSM target type is `ecs`.

ecs_cluster_region.description: The upstream ECS cluster region. Only used when service type is `aws_ssm`, and SSM target type is `ecs`.

ecs_service_name.description: The upstream ECS service name. Only used when service type is `aws_ssm`, and SSM target type is `ecs`.

eks_cluster_name.description: The EKS cluster name. Only used when service type is `kubectl_exec` and kubectl exec target type is `aws_eks`.

eks_cluster_region.description: The EKS cluster region. Only used when service type is `kubectl_exec` and kubectl exec target type is `aws_eks`.

namespace_allowlist.description: List of allowed Kubernetes namespaces. Only used when service type is `kubectl_exec`.

private_key.description: The upstream private key. Only used when authentication type is `private_key`.

service_type.description: The upstream service type. Valid values: `standard`, `aws_ec2_instance_connect`, `aws_ssm`, `kubectl_exec`, `docker_exec`, `connector_built_in_ssh_service`. Defaults to `standard`.

ssm_target_type.description: The upstream SSM target type. Valid values: `ec2`, `ecs`. Defaults to `ec2`. Only used when service type is `aws_ssm`.

username_provider.description: The upstream username provider. Valid values: `defined`, `prompt_client`, `use_connector_user`. Defaults to `prompt_client`.
